review_scope: Independent read-only policy review of root-authored verifier changes versus qualified main; no root edits and no product implementation.
result: PASS: no new security blocker; 22 applicable Python regressions actually passed in the unchanged canonical bwrap boundary.
docker_disposition: Only a fresh fixed /fault-fs tmpfs is added: rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=1m,mode=700 and the existing invoking UID/GID.

The same immutable built image ID, pull-never, network-none, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only root, existing readonly source/tools binds, private writable state, PID/memory/CPU limits and invoking UID/GID are preserved.

The read-only private /run mask remains unchanged. No privileged mode, host bind, socket, inherited home, seccomp-unconfined override or runtime-mask override was introduced. Docker default seccomp/runtime masking policy is unchanged.
The extra capacity is independent disposable kernel tmpfs rather than a new host bind; it does not grant new host filesystem or network access.
native_boundary_disposition: Existing unshare-all, cap-drop ALL, readonly mounts/root, cleared allowlisted environment and process/output/time limits are unchanged.

Actual /fault-fs mount is tmpfs with size1024k, mode700, uid1000/gid1000, nosuid,nodev. Unlike the explicit Docker option, bwrap does not add noexec; this does not expand privilege beyond its existing writable scratch/execution state.
The two original exact harness sandbox methods and exact unmapped-peer-PID Rust method remain unchanged; the same five-check native inventory and fail-closed no-skip interpretation remain mandatory.
fixture_disposition: The independently reviewed Python fault fixture checks no-follow lstat directory type, exact0700 mode, caller ownership, exactly one fixed mountpoint, tmpfs type and positive capacity <=1MiB before its first write.
It creates only an owned temporary regular file, attempts at most257 writes of4096bytes, requires actual ENOSPC and checks cleanup. There is no fallback directory or host-volume fill.

The storage Rust ENOSPC fixture was authored by this reviewer previously, so this report does not claim independent authorship separation for that fixture; its prior independent storage review remains separate.
inventory_disposition: Four explicit --test families are added to portable/all with locked/offline/all-features flags and nonzero-success validation. The actual test runs exercise missing/empty target rejection and missing/skipped native method rejection. Portable32, all34 and native5 inventories remain distinct.
